scope: Local isolated smart_campus database and one newly generated DEMO case only

injection.predicate: one exact case_id AND action=NOTE AND exact BINARY TEST note

checks.name: client configuration is restricted local file
connection uses only the configured isolated local socket
actual database identity matches isolated local runtime
injection case is an independent local DEMO case
case is IN_PROGRESS before fault injection
no preexisting trigger will be modified
timeline insert failure rejects API note operation
real MySQL state and timeline fully rolled back
API readback also retains exact version and timeline
normal note write and audit recover after injection removal
only the QA DEMO case completed through normal workflow

boundaries: Real MySQL transaction test; does not validate physical hardware
